head.description: UPerNet (PANGAEA SegUPerNet layout) on 4 frozen layers; Feature2Pyramid neck x4/x2/x1/maxpool; decoder channels 128 (PANGAEA default 512); neck=fused; PPM scales 1,2,3,6; BN; Dropout2d 0.1; bilinear upsample to 256x256; 2 classes; in_channels 1024
head.decoder: UPerNet (PPM 1,2,3,6 + FPN) on a Feature2Pyramid neck (x4 deconv, x2 deconv, identity, maxpool /2)

training.schedule: cosine decay per step from lr to 0 over max epochs
training.early_stopping: pooled val mIoU (metrics.py, 2 classes); best-epoch weights restored
training.epoch: all A x N (aug, patch) pairs once, seeded shuffle

sidecar.input: Sentinel-2 L2A B2,B3,B4,B5,B8,B8A,B11,B12 reflectance 0..1 (no SAR; Sentinel-1 not used); FLORO-pretraining z=(x-mean_floro)/(std_floro+1e-6) with floro.yaml floro_stats (as NormalizeWithValidity in FLORO pretraining) after physical range check (optical 0..1, sar -60..20) and finite check; a band group (BGR, RE, NIR, NIR2, SWIR, SAR VV+VH) with any invalid band -> NaN -> FLORO_Wrapper input_scale=floro_norm (0 with validity channel 0); dataset mean/std not used; availability_validity_mode=original, mask ratios 0, absolute pos-emb
sidecar.axes: aug, patch, layer, channel, grid_h, grid_w
sidecar.input_scale_rationale: default, fixed a priori: identical to FLORO pretraining (NormalizeWithValidity with floro_stats, invalid band group -> 0 with validity 0); not chosen from any probe or test number
